_core: Google's PRIMARY category says this is a window or door installer. Any of these keeps the lead. A shop that only does doors, or only windows, still counts (Jake, 2026-10-09).
_conditional: Primary is something broader. Kept only when the NAME says window or door AND a window/door category sits somewhere in the list. Catches 'Smith Windows & Siding' filed as a siding contractor.
_name_only: Google files many real installers as a bare 'Door supplier' or 'Window supplier'. Kept when the NAME says window or door, unless a garage door category sits anywhere in the list (pilot 2026-10-09: 34 door shops dropped without this).
_name_deny: Drops the lead whatever its category. Whole words, case-insensitive. Garage doors are their own trade.
_franchises: Big brands and national chains. Whole-word match on the name, case-insensitive.
_max_reviews: Above this the shop is too big to be an owner-operator.
_service: Every lead is 'window and door', whether the shop does one or both: it reads right in every text.
_line_types: Twilio line_type_intelligence types that get a text.
